tasks.subject: Task 0: Project Scaffold
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Create directory structure, dependency files, .gitignore, and example config.

**Verify:** `pytest tests/ --collect-only` -> exits 0

```json:metadata
{"files": ["birdwatch/__init__.py", "birdwatch/api/__init__.py", "tests/__init__.py", "requirements.txt", "requirements-dev.txt", ".gitignore", "config/config.example.yaml"], "verifyCommand": "pytest tests/ --collect-only", "acceptanceCriteria": ["pip install completes", "pytest collects without import errors", "config.example.yaml is valid YAML"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 1: Config Model
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Pydantic config models + load_config() with validation.

**Files:** `birdwatch/config.py`, `tests/test_config.py`

**Verify:** `pytest tests/test_config.py -v` -> `5 passed`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["birdwatch/config.py", "tests/test_config.py"], "verifyCommand": "pytest tests/test_config.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["load_config parses valid YAML", "invalid confidence raises ValidationError", "invalid log level raises ValidationError", "missing location raises ValidationError"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Database Layer
tasks.description:
**Goal:** SQLite schema (WAL), CRUD helpers for cameras/detections/alert_rules.

**Files:** `birdwatch/database.py`, `tests/test_database.py`

**Verify:** `pytest tests/test_database.py -v` -> `8 passed`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["birdwatch/database.py", "tests/test_database.py"], "verifyCommand": "pytest tests/test_database.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["init_db idempotent", "insert_detection returns int ID", "list_detections filters work", "camera CRUD round-trips", "alert_rule CRUD round-trips"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Camera Worker
tasks.description:
**Goal:** FFmpeg RTSP/RTSPS audio capture, PCM chunking with overlap, backpressure, reconnect.

**Files:** `birdwatch/camera_worker.py`, `tests/test_camera_worker.py`

**Verify:** `pytest tests/test_camera_worker.py -v` -> `5 passed`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["birdwatch/camera_worker.py", "tests/test_camera_worker.py"], "verifyCommand": "pytest tests/test_camera_worker.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["chunk_pcm_buffer splits correctly", "RTSPS URL adds -tls_verify 0", "RTSP URL has no -tls_verify", "backpressure drops chunks when queue full"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Inference Worker
tasks.description:
**Goal:** birdnetlib integration, PCM-to-WAV, analyze, save clips, push results.

**Files:** `birdwatch/inference_worker.py`, `tests/test_inference_worker.py`

**Verify:** `pytest tests/test_inference_worker.py -v` -> `5 passed`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["birdwatch/inference_worker.py", "tests/test_inference_worker.py"], "verifyCommand": "pytest tests/test_inference_worker.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["pcm_to_wav_file produces valid WAV", "build_clip_path returns correct path", "save_clip creates parent dirs", "slug handles apostrophes"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Alert Manager
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Rule matching, cooldown enforcement, email/webhook/pushover dispatch.

**Files:** `birdwatch/alert_manager.py`, `tests/test_alert_manager.py`

**Verify:** `pytest tests/test_alert_manager.py -v` -> `6 passed`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["birdwatch/alert_manager.py", "tests/test_alert_manager.py"], "verifyCommand": "pytest tests/test_alert_manager.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["null species_filter matches all", "species filter only fires for matching species", "confidence below threshold does not fire", "cooldown suppresses second detection", "disabled rule does not fire"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: Process Manager
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Spawn/supervise camera and inference worker subprocesses, heartbeat, auto-restart.

**Files:** `birdwatch/process_manager.py`

**Verify:** `python -c "from birdwatch.process_manager import ProcessManager; print('ok')"` -> `ok`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["birdwatch/process_manager.py"], "verifyCommand": "python3 -c \"from birdwatch.process_manager import ProcessManager; print('ok')\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["start_all spawns workers", "get_camera_statuses returns status per camera", "stop_all joins all processes"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 7: REST API — Detections & Cameras
tasks.description:
**Goal:** GET /api/detections, GET /api/detections/summary, CRUD /api/cameras.

**Files:** `birdwatch/api/detections.py`, `birdwatch/api/cameras.py`, tests

**Verify:** `pytest tests/api/test_detections.py tests/api/test_cameras.py -v` -> `8 passed`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["birdwatch/api/detections.py", "birdwatch/api/cameras.py", "tests/api/test_detections.py", "tests/api/test_cameras.py"], "verifyCommand": "pytest tests/api/test_detections.py tests/api/test_cameras.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["GET /api/detections returns list with filters", "GET /api/detections/summary returns counts", "POST /api/cameras returns 201", "DELETE /api/cameras/{id} returns 404 for unknown"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 8: REST API — Settings, Alerts & Clips
tasks.description:
**Goal:** GET/PUT /api/settings, CRUD /api/alerts/rules, GET /api/clips/{path}.

**Files:** `birdwatch/api/settings.py`, `birdwatch/api/alerts.py`, `birdwatch/api/clips.py`, tests

**Verify:** `pytest tests/api/test_settings.py tests/api/test_alerts.py -v` -> `6 passed`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["birdwatch/api/settings.py", "birdwatch/api/alerts.py", "birdwatch/api/clips.py", "tests/api/test_settings.py", "tests/api/test_alerts.py"], "verifyCommand": "pytest tests/api/test_settings.py tests/api/test_alerts.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["GET /api/settings returns lat/lon/confidence", "PUT /api/settings updates in memory", "alert rule CRUD round-trips", "GET /api/clips blocks path traversal"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 9: Main Entrypoint & WebSocket
tasks.description:
**Goal:** FastAPI app, lifespan wiring, WebSocket /ws/detections, result_queue consumer, graceful shutdown.

**Files:** `main.py`

**Verify:** `python3 -c "from main import create_app; print('ok')"` -> `ok`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["main.py"], "verifyCommand": "python3 -c \"from main import create_app; print('ok')\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["app starts without errors", "GET /api/detections returns 200", "WS /ws/detections accepts connection", "SIGTERM triggers graceful shutdown"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 10: Dashboard Frontend
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Tab-based SPA with Live/History/Cameras/Settings tabs. Alpine.js + HTMX, no build step.

**Files:** `birdwatch/static/index.html`, `birdwatch/static/app.js`, `birdwatch/static/style.css`

**Verify:** Manual — open http://<server>:8080/ in browser

```json:metadata
{"files": ["birdwatch/static/index.html", "birdwatch/static/app.js", "birdwatch/static/style.css"], "verifyCommand": "manual browser test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["all tabs load without console errors", "live tab updates via WebSocket", "history tab loads and filters detections", "cameras tab add/remove works", "settings tab reads and writes config"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 11: Systemd Service & README
tasks.description:
**Goal:** systemd unit file for 24/7 operation and full README.

**Files:** `birdwatch.service`, `README.md`

**Verify:** `sudo systemctl status birdwatch` -> `active (running)`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["birdwatch.service", "README.md"], "verifyCommand": "systemctl status birdwatch", "acceptanceCriteria": ["service starts with systemctl start", "service enables on boot", "logs appear in journald", "README covers install/config/run/upgrade"]}
```
